execution_preconditions: The ACT and CAMB authorities must match the materialization receipt exactly.
The exact LCDM parameter/prior configuration must be persisted before sampling begins.
Sampler implementation/version, random seed policy, number of chains or equivalent live-state policy, and stopping/convergence criteria must be persisted before interpreting outputs.
Raw chain or sampler-state custody must be uploaded, not only posterior summaries.
Any reference posterior used for comparison must have explicit source/version and parameter-convention mapping.
required_outputs: reference-comparison table with parameter convention mapping
failure/exception logs if execution does not converge
falsifiers: ACT or CAMB authority differs from the verified materialization without a new materialization receipt
priors or sampler settings are chosen after seeing the posterior
convergence criteria are absent or fail
only a best fit is produced instead of a posterior chain/state
reference posterior convention cannot be mapped
close_when: all required configuration fields are frozen
posterior/reference comparison is stored with immutable custody
claim_boundary: This contract and its future execution concern LCDM posterior reproduction through the verified ACT DR6 stack. They do not validate RLL CMB perturbations.
